question: What are the original search defaults, supported matching modes and file filters?
probes: Decompile criteria setup and search initialization
Capture original window and UI tree
resolution: Captured the original Main window: separate file name/content/location inputs, checked subfolders, size KB and modified dates, Start/Stop, results and summary. Decompiled criteria binding at 0x1400e1b80 and engine startup at 0x1400b8060. SearchLib 0x1800af8f0 confirms automatic workers = logical processors, bounded to 1..1024; 0x180048e10 confirms separate expression engines. Local help establishes whole-file Boolean default and strict wildcard behavior. Original user-specific saved criteria are not product defaults; XtraSearch starts at Documents with all names.
